listing.name: Shantae / shantaerecomp (vibecodekun)
listing.summary: Add Shantae Recomp for your own exact USA ROM and keep its portable state.

steps.title: Complete supported preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Keep the complete shantae-recomp package for your system with its matching runtime libraries, assets, shaders, notices and any selected patches. Normal players use shantae.exe on Windows or shantae on Linux and the supported first-run ROM chooser; upstream owns preparation and replacement. The title’s PolyForm Noncommercial grant does not replace separately named engine, UI, shader, font or original-game terms.

steps.title: Keep your matching original
steps.instruction: Use your own exact Shantae USA Game Boy Color ROM, SHA-256 1b92e22d5510c51bab97d23074e4aad7464d93eb15f7596ef7da0a5efa27a19d, CRC32 E994B59B. Other releases including World, Switch and Limited Run Games are different ROMs. The chooser enables Play only for the accepted original or explicitly supported compiled patch variants; patch compatibility must be established for that actual build. No ROM is supplied or licensed by this registration.

steps.title: Add the supported prepared player
steps.instruction: Select shantae.exe (shantae on Linux) with its complete package directory as working directory and no arguments. The pinned native runtime runs the pre-boot launcher and game in-process for the normal session. Keep the supported public launcher entry and complete package; no private runner or per-title wrapper is introduced.

steps.title: Start any additional game sessions separately
steps.instruction: Ordinary Quit ends the current process. Only explicitly choosing Return to Launcher schedules an atexit restart after saves close: on Windows that restart creates a new process without waiting. Treat that successor as upstream activity outside the attached session. Close every actual player and reopened launcher before maintenance or another attachment; registration status does not establish successor adoption or termination. This preserves the optional feature and does not disable it with arguments.

steps.title: Review Play and retain external ownership
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact selected executable, established working directory and literal arguments, then choose Play separately. Removing registration preserves external files. Upstream and you retain one runtime-replacement owner; Portcove provides no external update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion. Close actual players and companions before deliberate maintenance, keep the old working copy and all effective data, then review/relink changed selected bytes.

warnings: No acquired-source-to-binary, gameplay, real-save, installed-client, Supported or protected acceptance is established. Preserve every original, runtime, save, setting, mod, cache, backup and custom root; another executable can share data.
Keep the whole creating package, original ROM and every effective external root.
Patch/native state compatibility is build-specific; do not infer save compatibility from another gbrecompiled game. Preserve per-shader licences and complete component notices.
The package includes an unlicensed gbrecompiled engine fork that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

references.title: Preserve the whole copy and effective data
references.instruction: Keep the whole creating package, original ROM and every effective external root. Windows defaults portable state beside the executable; GBRECOMP_STATE_DIR overrides state and GBRECOMP_ASSET_DIR overrides assets. Preserve rom.cfg, keybinds.ini, runtime_prefs.ini, imgui.ini, shantae.ini, .sav battery data, .rtc, .stateN, map/patch-specific data, mods, shader_presets, shader_cache, logs and backups. Patch/native state compatibility is build-specific; do not infer save compatibility from another gbrecompiled game. Preserve per-shader licences and complete component notices.
